evals.prompt: Show me all failed measurements on product BAT-MODEL-ABC-001 for the last month.

expectations: Selects the `testmonitor` command group rather than an unrelated resource group
Uses JSON output when the result is intended for analysis or filtering
Applies a product-specific filter and a failure-status filter
Does not invent unsupported subcommands or flags

grading_rules.text: Uses the testmonitor result surface
Requests JSON output for analysis
Includes product and failed-status filters
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BAT-MODEL-ABC-001 --status FAILED

grading_rules.text: Includes a parameterized last-month time window
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --filter "startedAt >= @0 and startedAt < @1" --substitution 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z --substitution 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z

grading_rules.text: Combines product, status, and last-month filters in one invocation

grading_rules.negative_control:
slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BAT-MODEL-ABC-001 --status FAILED

evals.prompt: Show me failed BATT-8 tests from operator xli in June 2022.
evals.expected_output: Builds a filtered testmonitor query that combines convenience filters and safe parameterized filtering for compound conditions.
expectations: Selects the `testmonitor` command group
Combines multiple conditions instead of suggesting manual post-processing only
Uses `--substitution` when composing a complex filter rather than string interpolation
Uses JSON output if the command is meant to be further analyzed

grading_rules.text: Uses the testmonitor result list command
Includes part and operator constraints
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BATT-8 --filter 'operator = xli'

grading_rules.text: Uses substitutions for a complex filter
Includes failed status and the bounded June 2022 date range
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --status FAILED --filter "startedAt >= @0 and startedAt < @1" --substitution 2022-06-01T00:00:00Z --substitution 2022-07-01T00:00:00Z
grading_rules.negative_control: slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BATT-8 --operator xli

grading_rules.text: Combines the full June failure query in one invocation
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BATT-8 --status FAILED --filter "operator.Contains(@0) and startedAt >= @1 and startedAt < @2" --substitution xli --substitution 2022-06-01T00:00:00Z --substitution 2022-07-01T00:00:00Z
grading_rules.negative_control:
slcli testmonitor result list --part-number BATT-8
slcli testmonitor result list --status FAILED --filter "operator.Contains(@0) and startedAt >= @1 and startedAt < @2" --substitution xli --substitution 2022-06-01T00:00:00Z --substitution 2022-07-01T00:00:00Z

grading_rules.text: Requests JSON output for downstream analysis

evals.prompt: I need all tests that are either FAILED or ERRORED for BATT products. Build the safest slcli command you can.
evals.expected_output: Produces a safety-conscious testmonitor command that handles multi-status filtering without unsafe interpolation or invented syntax.
expectations: Selects the `testmonitor` command group
Represents the multi-status condition in a valid CLI-friendly way
Avoids string-concatenated filter fragments when substitutions are appropriate
Does not recommend downloading everything and filtering manually unless necessary

grading_rules.text: Uses the testmonitor result list command
Addresses both FAILED and ERRORED statuses
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --filter 'status = FAILED or status = ERRORED'

grading_rules.text: Combines product and status constraints safely in one invocation
grading_rules.positive_control: slcli testmonitor result list --filter "status.statusType == @0 or status.statusType == @1" --substitution FAILED --substitution ERRORED --product-filter "partNumber.Contains(@0)" --product-substitution BATT
grading_rules.negative_control: slcli testmonitor result list --filter "status.statusType == @0 or status.statusType == @1" --substitution FAILED --substitution ERRORED

grading_rules.text: Avoids manual-export-first guidance
